name: Feature request
about: Propose a new procedure, module, or language-level capability
title: ""
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## What's missing

What can't you do today, or what's awkward? Concrete code you wish worked
is more useful than an abstract description:

```scheme
;; what you wish you could write
```

## Why

What's the actual use case driving this? (Not "it would be nice" — what are
you actually trying to build?)

## Proposed shape, if you have one

A rough sketch of the API/procedure signature/module boundary, if you have
an opinion. Not required — "here's the problem, no strong opinion on the
solution" is a fine issue too.

## Prior art

Does another Scheme (or another language) already solve this well? Link to
it if so — SRFIs in particular are worth citing by number.

## Scope check

- [ ] I've checked [`docs/reference/`](../../docs/reference/) and
      [`docs/thoughts/`](../../docs/thoughts/) to see whether this is already
      planned, in progress, or intentionally out of scope.
